engineer.text: Copy — wrench is moving.
Thanks — that saves me a teardown.
Sounds like a solid build.

comms.text: Copy that — five by five.
Thanks — relaying it now.
Sounds like a go for relay.

director.text: Copy — noted in the log.
Thanks — the board is updated.
Sounds go for flight.

astronaut.speaker: leo_marchetti
astronaut.text: Land smooth and your spine will thank us both.

engineer.speaker: leo_marchetti
engineer.text: Better seals, fewer bruises — keep at it.

physicist.speaker: leo_marchetti
physicist.text: Shield numbers look great — my dosimeter agrees.

mathematician.speaker: leo_marchetti
mathematician.text: Even your sleep schedule looks optimized.

biologist.speaker: leo_marchetti
biologist.text: Your herbal shelf is half my pharmacy.

medical.speaker: leo_marchetti
medical.text: A second medic on board — the crew is lucky.

comms.speaker: leo_marchetti
comms.text: Night-shift coffee is not a meal — I'm watching you.

director.speaker: leo_marchetti
director.text: Schedule rest like it's a launch window — please.

lines.speaker: yuki_tanaka
lines.text: I listen every day. Even silence tells us something.

astronaut.text: Copy — logged in the flight notes.

engineer.text: Understood — tools out.
Good to know — I'll re-check the torque.
I'll keep that on my checklist.

physicist.text: I'll keep that in the equations.

mathematician.text: I'll keep that in my proof.

biologist.text: Good to know — the garden will like that.
I'll keep that in my field notes.

medical.text: Good to know — noted on the chart.
I'll keep that in mind — and in the med kit.

comms.text: Understood — channel clear.
Good to know — copying it to the log.
I'll keep that on my board.

director.text: Understood — console watches.
Good — logged for the mission board.
I'll keep that in the flight rules.

astronaut.speaker: yuki_tanaka
astronaut.text: Your radio calls are the crispest on the crew.

engineer.speaker: yuki_tanaka
engineer.text: You fixed the hum in my headset — you're a hero.

physicist.speaker: yuki_tanaka
physicist.text: Explain the antenna physics again — slower this time?

biologist.speaker: yuki_tanaka
biologist.text: The crew loves the garden updates — keep them coming.

medical.speaker: yuki_tanaka
medical.text: Hold music for patients while they wait? Only from you.

comms.speaker: yuki_tanaka
comms.text: Two operators, one console — the airwaves are safe.

director.speaker: yuki_tanaka
director.text: Your calm voice steadies every room.
